company_profile: A Nordic bank whose Personal Customers AI Centre of Excellence builds conversational AI and self-service assistants for its retail customers.
title: AI Engineer for Agentic AI
summary: Senior AI Engineer with 8+ years building ML and LLM systems in Python and taking them to production across Healthcare, Telecom and AIOps. Designs LangGraph multi-agent workflows with tool orchestration, RAG pipelines over structured and unstructured data, and conversational agents with multi-turn reasoning, backed by LLM evaluation, tracing and failure detection. Ships with FastAPI, Docker, Kubernetes and Databricks, working with stakeholders to turn business problems into measurable results. Alongside this, I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD.

project.name: Self-Service Multi-Agent Assistant
bullets: Built a multi-agent assistant for retail banking self-service in LangGraph, where a router delegates to specialist agents that call tools through MCP and query a RAG knowledge base.
Evaluated relevance, faithfulness and hallucination with LLM judges on a regression suite, then deployed on AWS Bedrock behind FastAPI in Docker with structured logging and tracing.

paragraphs: I am applying for the AI Engineer for Agentic AI role in Danske Bank's Conversational AI unit. As a Senior AI Engineer I build LangGraph multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines and agent evaluation that run in production. What ties it together is making agents that people can trust to finish a task on their own.

Danske Bank is moving its AI Assistant from answering questions to letting customers resolve things themselves, which is a hard and useful problem in a regulated setting. I have built for healthcare, so I know how much care that takes. My fiancée lives in Berlin, and we plan to move to Copenhagen together and settle there long term.

I would bring two things the role leans on. I built a production multi-agent chatbot in LangGraph with multi-turn reasoning that cut manual analysis by 98%. I also built evaluation and observability pipelines with LLM evaluators and tracing that reduced human review by 43% and catch regressions as prompts and models change.

Outside work I am building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI learning platform used by NGO teachers to support students with ADHD. It keeps me honest about building for real people who have no patience for a tool that gets things wrong. I would be glad to talk about how I could help the team.
